original.statement: Crossplane v2.0 requires sequential upgrade through intermediate v1 minor versions, with mandatory upgrade to v1.20 as the final v1 step before upgrading to v2.0; direct upgrade from earlier v1 versions to v2.0 is not supported.

corrected.statement: Environments upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 from a v1 version older than v1.20 are exposed. They should first upgrade one minor version at a time up to v1.20 so that the CRD storage migrations run at each minor release.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] says operators should be running a v1.20 version before upgrading to v2.0 and should move through one minor version at a time. That makes the exposed environments those upgrading from a version below v1.20.0, which edge-from-version <1.20.0 already expresses. The proposed second leaf misuses cluster-version: that op is for the platform version, and Crossplane is not the platform. It also repeats the from-version constraint, so it should be dropped.
